info.desc: Superunknown is the fourth album by the American grunge band Soundgarden. It was released on March 8, 1994 through A&M Records. The band began work on the album after touring in support of its previous album, Badmotorfinger. The resulting album captured the creativity and heaviness of the band's earlier releases while displaying a more diverse range of influences. The album was a critical and commercial success and became the band's breakout album. It peaked at number one on the Billboard 200 and reached high positions on charts worldwide. podcast.body: This album was released in March 1994 and was described as the record that made Soundgarden "superstars." "Sound Garden would release their Super Unknown album, which is the record that really made them superstars."

podcast.body: Released the same day as *The Downward Spiral*, Soundgarden's fourth studio album debuted at number one in the US, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, reached the top ten in the UK, Denmark, Finland, Norway, and Switzerland, spawned five successful singles, won two Grammy Awards, and sold approximately 10 million copies worldwide. Most fans and critics consider it Soundgarden's best record. "Considered by most fans to be Sound Garden's best record."

podcast.body: Soundgarden was given the necessary time and resources to develop their unique sound and reach their full potential, a process that culminated in the release of *Superunknown* in 1994. This album became a massive success, selling 10 million copies worldwide. SoundScan technology later confirmed that Soundgarden achieved proper, real number one records. "They were allowed to grow into their potential, something that took until the super unknown album of 1994, which eventually sold 10 million copies around the world."

podcast.body: Soundgarden's "Superunknown" holds the distinction of being the first grunge album to debut at number one on the album charts. This achievement occurred before Nirvana's "Nevermind," marking a significant milestone for the grunge genre. "It was actually super unknown from Soundgarden."
